components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Records or advances a real mission decision with the live coral signal.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font-family: 'Momentum Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(.96); }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Keeps the current theme explicit in a compact, labeled navigation control.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { height: 30px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-family: 'Momentum Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-toggle svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); color: var(--ink); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ledger Panel
components.description: A flat chapter container separated by graphite rules rather than ambient shadow.
components.html:
Today’s weighted commitments

0%
Mission status and execution rows belong here.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: 'Momentum Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-panel header { min-height: 74px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 19px 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 690; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-panel header strong { font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 20px 22px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Weighted Check Row
components.description: Records one binary commitment while keeping its goal and point weight visible.
components.css: .ds-check-row { min-height: 74px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font-family: 'Momentum Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-check-row:hover { background: var(--surface); } .ds-check-row input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-check { width: 22px; height: 22px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--paper); color: transparent; font-size: 11px; } .ds-check-row input:checked + .ds-check { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green); color: var(--signal-ink); } .ds-check-row:has(input:checked) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--green-soft) 70%, transparent); } .ds-check-copy strong, .ds-check-copy small { display: block; } .ds-check-copy strong { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-check-copy small { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; } .ds-check-row em { padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 650; } .ds-check-row:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Metric Stepper
components.description: Updates a measured target with generous decrement and increment zones around a tabular input.
components.css: .ds-stepper { width: 188px; height: 44px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0,1fr) 44px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: 'Momentum Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-stepper button { border: 0; background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); font-size: 19px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stepper button:first-child { border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-stepper button:last-child { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-stepper button:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); } .ds-stepper button:focus-visible, .ds-stepper label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-stepper label { min-width: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-stepper input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; padding-left: 8px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); text-align: right; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 750; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stepper span { margin-right: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Chart Range
components.description: Switches analytical time windows without competing with the chart itself.
components.css: .ds-range { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface); font-family: 'Momentum Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-range button { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-range button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-range button.active { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); } .ds-range button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pairs compact metadata with a semantic state without becoming a decorative badge.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { min-height: 27px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 30%, var(--line)); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--green-soft); color: var(--green); font-family: 'Momentum Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-chip i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); }

narrative.overview:
Momentum is a live execution ledger, not a gallery of interchangeable cards. It should feel like a disciplined mission-control surface: dark by default, equally resolved on paper white, compact enough for repeated daily use, and calm enough that incomplete work remains legible without becoming punitive. Graphite rules establish order; coral identifies the live commitment; blue and green report data and completion.

The interface tells one continuous story: mission status, today’s weighted work, KPI proof, daily trend, weekly comparison, consistency, body evidence, and milestones. Panels are chapters in that ledger rather than self-promoting objects. Controls remain small and operational, while large tabular numerals and the opening statement carry visual authority.
keyCharacteristics: Dark midnight and paper-white canvases with the same semantic hierarchy.
Graphite borders and tonal fields instead of decorative depth.
Coral for live work, green for completion, blue for analytical comparison, and amber for caution or secondary goal data.
Compact controls, dense ledger rows, and tabular numerals.
Responsive reflow that preserves the mission-first reading order.

rules.name: The One Signal, One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Coral means live or urgent, green means complete or positive, blue means comparative data, and amber means caution or secondary data; never swap those meanings for decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Dark is the default, but every semantic role must remain equally legible and intentional on paper white; never treat light mode as a simple inversion.

rules.name: The Ledger Numeral Rule
rules.body: Quantitative values always use tabular figures so updates do not disturb alignment or scan rhythm.

rules.name: The One Display Moment Rule
rules.body: Reserve the large, tightly tracked display style for the page mission; downstream hierarchy is compact and workmanlike.

rules.name: The Story Survives Reflow Rule
rules.body: Responsive layout may change columns, density, and scrolling behavior, but it never changes the order from mission status to execution to proof.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by tone and 1px rules; never add ambient shadows to make routine panels feel important.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Corners become smaller as components move inward: panel, inset field, control, then check or cell. Do not repeat the same large radius at every nesting level.

dos: Do lead every screen with current mission status and the next recordable work.
Do preserve the semantic color contract across light and dark themes.
Do use graphite rules, shared containers, and tonal insets to expose hierarchy.
Do use tabular numerals for every changing quantity and pair data color with labels, arrows, icons, or text.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, semantic progress values, accessible chart names, touch-friendly controls, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep interaction copy direct, specific, and confidence-preserving.
donts: Don't turn the ledger into a gallery of floating, equally weighted cards.
Don't add decorative gradients, glowing borders, ambient shadows, glass effects, or effects without information value.
Don't use coral, green, blue, or amber as arbitrary decoration or as the only carrier of meaning.
Don't shrink labels below the established 11px floor or compress charts until their axes become unreadable.
Don't reorder analytics ahead of today’s weighted execution on smaller screens.
Don't introduce oversized controls, playful badges, or nested rounded containers that dilute the mission-control character.
